prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Rendering Tip Activity Display: Adds a dynamic tip carousel display and rendering countdown timer to the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "calm", "action": "open_tip"}]}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Multi Pet Synchronization Hint: Displays a clear sign-in hint reassuring users that signing in will automatically sync and restore existing desktop pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in automatically syncs and restores your existing desktop pets and companion data."}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Adoption Pet Companion Trait Selection Sub-Flow: Adds an interactive companion personality trait selection sub-flow during the pet picking stage.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select companion personality: Playful, Calm, or Energetic", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
3: [home, new_screen] Home Desktop Pet Hatching Minigame Screen: Inserts an interactive egg hatching minigame screen while pet rendering processes in the background.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_hatching_minigame", "home_intro"], "new_hatching_minigame": {"headline": "Interact with your pet egg while it finishes hatching!", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:egg_hatch", "style": "playful"}]}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Session Recovery Hint: Provides an explicit session recovery safety hint on sign-in to reassure users against app stalls and login failures.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Fast session authentication guarantees instant desktop pet retrieval without stalling."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Rendering Live Status Checklist: Replaces static wait status with a live multi-stage rendering progress checklist.
   config: {"waiting": {"replace": {"wait_status": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Generating pet model... Preparing desktop animations...", "style": "subtle", "role": "wait_status"}]}}}
6: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Finish Controls Overview Redesign: Redesigns the finish screen into a split layout showcasing quick desktop pet controls, tray shortcuts, and hide options.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Your Desktop Pet is Ready!", "body": "Click your pet or use the system tray menu to interact, open controls, or hide companion anytime.", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Desktop Pet Control Basics & Shortcut Guide", "style": "highlight", "role": "home_welcome"}]}}}
7: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Celebration Showcase Redesign: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a stage layout featuring live pet previews and progress indicators.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "show_progress": true, "replace": {"certificate": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_preview", "style": "large", "role": "certificate"}]}}}
8: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Companion Preview Hint: Adds an explanatory hint under path choices detailing how each path affects desktop pet interactions.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Your path selection determines your companion pet's daily desktop activities and behavior."}}
9: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Rendering Companion Mascot Display: Adds an animated companion mascot and progress bar during background rendering on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:mascot_waiting", "style": "playful"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adds tip carousel and rendering wait estimate without breaking rules.
Adds sign-in hint within onboarding without violating pricing or dark patterns.
Adds personality trait sub-flow selection during friend picking stage.
Inserts a new hatching minigame screen inside onboarding while preserving all mandatory steps.
Adds valid sign-in copy hint within onboarding guidelines.
Replaces static status with checklist while maintaining waiting screen job of showing pet creation progress.
Redesigns home_intro overlay layout within allowed onboarding scope.
Replacing the certificate component with a pet preview removes the official stamp required for the adoption certificate screen job.
Adds informational path preview hint without altering rules or pricing.
Adds progress bar and mascot component to waiting screen while retaining its job.
